Subject: Draft MAP — POC environment milestones & owners (post-call)

Hi Anna / Tom — thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and the MAP draft items we agreed to surface for your internal routing. I attached a first-pass MAP spreadsheet and our preflight checklist (see attachments).

High-level POC target
- POC target completion: 2026-10-15
- Redwood staging ready: target 2026-09-14

Key milestones (owners & asks)
1) VPC peering (Customer: Anna / NetOps) — Deliverables: peer request + account IDs, target CIDR to allow (expected by 2026-09-07). Redwood action: provide peer config and shared subnet guidance.
2) IP allowlist (Customer: Tom / Security) — Deliverables: list of static outbound IP blocks or proxy egress addresses; Redwood will provide our service egress range for staging. Please confirm by 2026-09-07.
3) SSO / SAML integration (Customer: designate SSO owner, share IdP metadata XML or metadata URL) — Redwood SE (Marissa) will run validation and provide SP metadata. Target: metadata exchange by 2026-09-10.
4) Secrets & KMS (Customer: confirm KMS provider and key policies) — If using customer-managed keys, please share key ARN and admin contact; otherwise we can provision customer-isolated keys in Redwood-managed KMS. Decision due 2026-09-10.
5) Test accounts & sample data (Customer: Tom) — Provide one test tenant, brief sample payloads, and any IP-based feature flags required to mirror production behavior.

Immediate asks for your team (48h)
- Confirm the internal owners for VPC peering, SSO, and KMS (name and email).
- Confirm whether KMS will be customer-managed or Redwood-managed (one-sentence).
- Provide preferred windows for a 60-minute preflight call (we're suggesting Sept 8–10).

Redwood owners (for clarity)
- Sales: Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer@redwood.com) — overall MAP coordinator / timelines
- Solutions Eng: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com) — SSO checks, network validation, test harness
- Customer Success: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.com) — POC acceptance criteria & support runbook

Attachments: MAP_Draft_V1.xlsx (MAP draft with Milestones / Owners / Target dates), redwood-preflight-checklist.pdf (preflight steps), network-diagram.png (proposed peering diagram).

Next step: once you confirm owners, Marissa will send a calendar invite for the preflight tech call and Ben will share the POC acceptance checklist. Let us know if any of the dates above need to shift — we can adjust the staging window accordingly.

Thanks,
Karthik
--
